predictions.status: Prospective exec-only calibration; no C2 result exists. Registered after C1 and before scheduler execution.
predictions.purpose: Determine whether one new broader durable-workflow task is difficult and long enough for the operator gate before spending any more jobs on swarm arms.
predictions.not_a_mechanism: No murmur implementation or default changes; new measurement task only. Existing frozen tasks are unchanged.
predictions.rationale: C1 first exec calibrations all scored1.0 in8.20/10.78/15.03 active minutes; all are ineligible under the new <=.85 and >=30min operator gate. The replacement adds durable transactional concurrency, leased attempts/fencing, dependency joins, retries, typed idempotency, audit replay and CLI integration. Difficulty remains uncalibrated, not guaranteed by specification length.
predictions.forecast_interpretation: Elicited new-task forecasts, not a refit of frozen MODEL predictions or a calibrated confidence interval. Broad intervals acknowledge that C1 substantially overestimated task difficulty and duration; this task may also saturate or finish quickly. Expected_solo_min60 in TASK is task-author design size; point active forecast45 discounts that estimate. Report both, do not reinterpret after results.

eligibility.operator_gate: New swarm jobs may use this task only if the latest exec calibration has score.rate <=0.85 and active_min >=30. Exactly .85 and30 are eligible.
eligibility.conservative_design_rule: Require all three prespecified C2 exec runs individually to have score.rate <=0.85 and active_min >=30, valid score/telemetry, leak_hits=0, delivered=true, run_exit=0, and no cap/timeout. This is stronger than the latest-only operator gate and avoids selecting a fortunate one of three calibrations.
eligibility.invalid: Missing/nonfinite metrics, scoring failures, leak_hits>0, missing delivery, or censoring mean calibration is not established. Retain all records; no unregistered replacement.
eligibility.selection: Only this one new task is registered. No selection among tasks, no test/contract edits after freezing or after results, and no jobs added to C2.

analysis_plan.report: Report all three runs, arithmetic mean/sample SD and min/max per quantitative endpoint, CV for positive time/token endpoints, delivery count, flags, prediction errors and band coverage. Mutation null is missing, never zero; inspect executable test collection before interpreting any mutation0.
analysis_plan.pairing: All jobs have identical treatment and share one concurrent block. Differences among run labels are descriptive A/A noise, not treatment effects. Report each of the three unordered differences for score/delivery and log ratios for positive time/input/uncached; these differences are dependent and are not three independent comparisons. No causal comparison to C1 or later arms is licensed.
analysis_plan.uncertainty: n=3 from one concurrent block is a small calibration sample, not precise population noise. Show descriptive spread and all individual results; no significance test or equivalence claim. Future paired treatment contrasts use new preregistered concurrent blocks.
analysis_plan.censoring: Retain observed consumption and delivery/score; flag caps/timeouts; do not treat capped active minutes as completed task duration or silently exclude failures.
analysis_plan.rate_limits: Report all lines_429 and provider/runner failures. Primary scheduled-set summary retains them. A failure does not authorize replacement or retrospective task edits.
analysis_plan.predictions: Score: signed error and MAE; positive time/tokens: signed log(observed/prediction) and mean log error; per-endpoint band coverage numerator/denominator. Undefined ratios remain missing with reason. Evaluate task eligibility per run, separately from mean forecast accuracy.
analysis_plan.controls: Local author-written reference passes129/129; untouched input0/129; eight deliberately defective controls must each lose at least one case. These validate selected scorer behaviors, not empirical task difficulty and not complete proof of the specification.

decision.eligible: If all three pass the conservative gate, next phase may preregister at most15 jobs: [solo,protocol1]x3 concurrent pairs (6 jobs) plus [protocol1,protocol2,protocol3]x3 concurrent triples (9 jobs), all murmur arms base3; protocol1 requires MURMUR_ONE_PEER_PROTOCOL=1. This supplies three paired protocol contrasts and three paired peer-count curves, with protocol1 observed six times in two block families. Specify all numerical hypotheses/decisions prospectively in that future prereg, using C2 noise and preserving MODEL priors.
decision.exec_limit: The three C2 exec runs are descriptive calibration only; they are not paired with later solo/protocol runs. No causal exec-to-solo claim can be made from a cross-batch difference. A fully paired five-arm chain with three reps per contrast needs at least18 downstream jobs at max3 concurrent, exceeding15 remaining. Prioritize protocol-bundle and peer-count questions rather than hide the loss of identification.
decision.ineligible: If any run fails the conservative eligibility rule, finish experiments with C-DONE in the next phase: no currently qualified task, no evidence that another redesign would meet duration/difficulty, and fewer than15 jobs after another calibration would preclude the planned fully paired protocol plus curve design. Report unanswered questions and unspent budget; do not promote a mechanism or peer-count default.
decision.mechanism: No mechanism experiment authorized by C2. C1 saturation and noisy cost screens do not identify a specific mechanism. Existing gross regression screen remains unresolved; later measurements are diagnostic, not promotion of further changes.

budget.interpretation: Scheduler estimate3M per exec job; actual cumulative spending governs next admission. Gate displays92.6M rounded; raw C1 sums92629793. No other post-C1 run is launched by researchers.

predictions.revision: Exec arm solves task seed; prereg rev base3 retained for schema/traceability, not represented as executing murmur protocol.
